mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-backend.md <<'EOF'

The project's current recorded decision is to use rustls as the TLS backend, chosen because it is pure Rust and avoids the complexity of C bindings.

cat docs/policies/tls-backend.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-backend.md`. It says the project's current recorded decision is rustls as the TLS backend, because it is pure Rust and avoids C binding complexity. It doesn't mention the retired OpenSSL choice.

The decision is Muninn record #16, which replaced #13 and #14. Nothing in the catalog or `muninn why` retires #16 itself. The catalog didn't list every record, so I can't rule out a later one I didn't see.

The Bash heredoc failed with a parser error, so I wrote the file with the Write tool instead. I haven't read it back.
